productionInspection: The three actual four-facing PNG production review captures show all twelve approved enemies beside the actual Cái Bang sprite. Wild Dog, Corrupted Monk and Stone Golem front frame PNGs plus the Cái Bang idle PNG were also opened directly.

style.camera: Elevated orthographic three-quarter overworld camera, visible top planes, four cardinal facings; no camera change.
style.linework: Thin dark stepped contours, clustered material shading and compact chibi proportions.
style.lighting: Warm upper-left highlights, restrained contact shadows on ivory concept presentation.
style.density: Approved concepts and actual production captures used together. New boards are enlarged concept illustrations, not pixel-calibrated gameplay sprites.

designComparisons.difference: Long low body, enlarged fanged jaw and forepaws, muscular shoulders, raised crimson hackles, red eyes and compact burning patches/paws; retains canine ears/tail/four-legged family silhouette. More than a recolor.
Smallest new humanoid, bright orange skin, short paired horns, yellow eyes, lean clawed limbs and compact hand flames. Distinct from dark quadruped, robe triangle and broad brute.

Narrow hooded/masked full-robed silhouette, eye slits, flame sigils and pointed crystal/lotus staff; contrasted with bald broad-armed prayer-bead martial monk. Right-hand staff corrected in final master and individual.

Bull muzzle, broad curved ivory horns, muscular V-shaped torso, bronze armor, hooves and crescent axe. Similar proposed mass to66px golem, but angular/armed/bipedal instead of rounded mossy stone fists.

reviewNotes: Scale figures, rulers and proposed logical-pixel numbers are illustrative and not pixel-calibrated production specifications. Approval and future Phase1H frame/footprint tests are still required.
Fire silhouettes are contained at paws/hands/staff; dark outlines preserve separation. Actual arena-grass readability/performance is not runtime-tested during this concept-only phase.

Small flame branches, fur highlights, horn/rivet grooves, robe embroidery and belt/clasp detail vary slightly between master and enlarged boards. Broad silhouettes, costume colors and weapon identity remain consistent.
Hound back flames sometimes read as branching ember fissures as well as flame patches; director should approve that treatment.
Brute horn/axe clearance and cultist staff height need future crowded-scene sizing review; no collision/range or balancing decision is implied.
corrections: Initial master had reversed hound/cultist side views, duplicated brute profile and inconsistent cultist staff hand. Two built-in image edits corrected the master; the final individual boards and delivered master were opened and checked.

approval.scope: Phase1G Waves13-16 master and four individual concept designs only. Production sprites, animations and runtime integration are outside this concept approval record.
